map.CPA单次获客成本计算器 使用指南: CPA cost per acquisition calculator guide
map.输入营销总花费与获得的新付费客户数，计算单次获客成本（CPA），对比各渠道效率并: Enter total marketing spend and the number of new paying customers acquired to compute cost per acquisition (CPA), comparing channel efficiency and evaluating marketing return.
map.按总花费和新增客户算 CPA，并拆 CPC。: Compute CPA from total spend and new customers, and break out CPC.
map.结合毛利率算净 ROI 与回本周期。: Combine gross margin to get net ROI and the payback period.
map.用复购率估 LTV，看 LTV:CPA 是否健康。: Estimate LTV from the repeat purchase rate and check whether LTV:CPA is healthy.
map.：总花费 10000、新增客户 200 → CPA=50；点击 5000 → C: : total spend 10,000, 200 new customers -> CPA = 50; 5,000 clicks -> CPC = 2; order value 300 -> revenue 60,000, gross margin 30% -> gross profit 18,000, net profit 8,000, ROI = 8000/10000 = 80%.
map.：复购率 30%、单客利润 150 → 估 LTV≈150/(1−0.3)≈21: : repeat purchase rate 30%, profit per customer 150 -> estimated LTV about 150/(1 - 0.3), about 214; LTV:CPA = 214/50, about 4.3:1, at or above 3 so healthy, allowing more spend.
map.没有绝对值，看 LTV:CPA。比值≥3 可持续，1–3 需优化，<1 亏损。: There is no absolute value; look at LTV:CPA. A ratio of 3 or more is sustainable, 1-3 needs optimization, below 1 is a loss.
map.净 ROI 和广告 ROI 区别？: Difference between net ROI and advertising ROI?
map.本工具毛利已扣货成本，净 ROI 比只看收入的广告 ROI 更接近真实盈利。: This tool already deducts cost of goods from gross profit, so net ROI is closer to real profit than ad ROI that only looks at revenue.
